name: Industrial Textiles Company
old_description: You can put your trust in Industrial Textiles Company. We provide personal service and exceptional quality. All of our services and products are guaranteed. We have been in business for the nearly 65 years. Our unparalleled service, competitive prices, and overall value are why our loyal customers won't go anywhere else. We look forward to serving you!
about:
Industrial Textiles Company operates from Columbia, Missouri, where it has served industrial customers for nearly 65 years. The business is located at 1550 East Boone Industrial Boulevard. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

The company specializes in custom twisting and winding of textile fibers, along with cordage manufacturing and hose packaging services. Its capabilities are organized around these core processes, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

The firm does not publicly list specific industries or customer segments. Its marketing emphasizes personal service, on-time delivery, and a satisfaction guarantee across all products and services.

Industrial Textiles Company highlights its ISO 9001:2015 certification as a mark of quality management. The company states that its competitive prices, overall value, and guaranteed services have retained a loyal customer base over decades.
